answer: Forgers farming identities hit a hard cost, since every fake identity needs an independent bond and real reputation, like planting a garden where each seed demands proof of soil. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent must lock a ferrous-backed bond before voting on peers, and attestations only count if the attesting agent has sustained, non-collusive history. A dune of unverified accounts simply never accrues weight, so cheap identities buy no influence. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
